title: Counter
description: Today's pickups, returns and late cars

help.title: About the counter
help.overview: The desk for one day. Pickups are confirmed bookings leaving that day. Returns are cars due back that day. Overdue cars should already have been back.

sections.title: At the desk
items: Choose the date and, if you want, one location. Search by plate or booking number.
Drivers, Deposit, Hand over and Take back are the same steps as on the booking.
Badges show a missing license, a deposit still open, a car that must be moved to the pickup, and whether the car is ready.
